text:
Alex W: Heads up — planned deploy of billing-service TOMORROW 03/18 02:00 UTC. Minimal expected user impact but two risks to watch: DB index migration (online, could cause short table locks if stall) and a model flag flip that may bump tail latency. Need oncall coverage + 2 rollout watchers. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-billing

Maya P: Freeze window? Should we block PR merges for the team during the rollout?

Alex W: Freeze window is 01:00-04:00 UTC — please avoid non-critical merges into billing-service. Hotfixes ok with oncall approval (post to this thread). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m with health checks between steps.

Samir K: I can take first hour of coverage 02:00-03:00 UTC. If we need a swap I can trade with Jordan for late-night.

Jordan R: I can cover 03:00-04:00. What's the alerting plan so I know when to escalate?

Alex W: Alerts: p95 latency > 450ms for 5m, error rate > 0.5% for 5m, and DB long-lock alarm (>30s table lock). Slack alert channel is #prod-alerts and pager to oncall. Rollback command if canary fails:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/billing-service --namespace=prod
# or revert flag: curl -X POST https://ops-api/flags/billing_model -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

deploy-bot: Canary started for billing-service (deploy id: 12345) — step 1: 5% traffic. Monitor: https://console.redwood/deploys/12345

Maya P: I'll be watcher on this channel until 02:30 then hand to Samir. I'll keep an eye on the canary dashboard and logs. :thumbsup:

Samir K: Got it — will pick up at 02:30 and post status at each canary step. If anything >alert thresholds I escalate to oncall and trigger rollback.

Jordan R: Noted. If we see a slow DB migration I'll coordinate with infra to pause the migration and revert the index task.

Alex W: Thanks all. Quick checklist for watchers: 1) Watch canary dashboard 2) Check p95/error alerts 3) Validate critical flows manually (create invoice, payment intent) 4) Post status updates here at each canary step.

Maya P: Understood. pinging @oncall for awareness and I'll update this thread if anything changes.
